source_access.scope: The protected selected cache is abstract-only. Authentic author-repository full text was separately read at lines 148–180, 250–286 and 1456–1505. Thirty-six exact positive records authenticate twelve COA7 pairs, with fragment limits preserved and no pair-specific DULIP claim.

Selected original strategy, Results and Methods plus genuine Table S1 were read. COA7/Q96BR5 appears at all-protein row 222 and MitoCoP row 197. This validates the target relationship and broad mitochondrial location without claiming every individual validation assay tested COA7.

Selected complete primary Results/Methods and the independently sealed supplemental consultation support recombinant human COA7 heme binding, SCO disulfide reduction and human cellular assembly/redox rescue. Human protein was expressed in E. coli; soluble SCO domains were tested. No physiological upstream donor, catalytic cycling, heme delivery or copper-chaperone role was demonstrated.

The selected cache contains the abstract, Introduction and Discussion, without separate Results/Methods. Three exact HCT116 anti-tag coimmunoprecipitation records directly authenticate the ACOT8, DPP8 and C11orf54 associations.

Selected human-cell Results, localization legends and Methods were read. Cysteine-dependent CHCHD4 association, mitochondrial import, swelling/protease assays and compartment-resolved imaging support substrate import and IMS residence. Reciprocal COA7 overexpression controls do not establish an import-catalyst role.

The authentic abstract reports soluble human mitochondrial IMS localization and depletion-associated respiratory defects, strongest for complex-IV assembly. The full original paper was not recovered; later independent human experiments support the retained annotations.

Selected Results/Discussion and validation legends were read, not a separate Methods section. Fifteen exact positive records authenticate five COA7 partner pairs, including validated yeast two-hybrid retests; dataset-wide MAPPIT/GPCA validation is not assigned to each pair.

Original U2OS AP-MS Methods, BioPlex comparison and data-availability locator were read. The complete linked NDEx network directly contains ACOT8, DPP8 and C11orf54 edges to COA7; each partner is bait and COA7 is prey. These are original AP-MS edges, not merely inferred image proximity.

Complete authentic abstract and selected respiratory-assay Results/Table 2 text were read. Four human families and patient-cell defects support SCAN3 disease context; the fly perturbations and variable complex-I/IV effects are not converted into new human developmental or complex-I functions.

Complete abstract and selected actual Methods, human rescue Results and suborganellar localization Discussion were read. Clinical/complex-IV rescue evidence remains valid; the matrix-localization interpretation is disputed by later independent swelling/protease and imaging experiments.
